column1: # what one delivered ribbon costs in machine time, over the SIX seeds of seed-search-1447 that have both a measured fan out and a c stage time in both arms of c-stage-cost. growth_seconds is from per-seed.csv; c_stage_before is reference_seconds and c_stage_after is arm_seconds of arm c2 in c-stage-cost/evidence/c-stage-times.csv. The l, vm, hm and fm stages are seconds and are NOT in these sums, which are therefore the growth and the c stage only and are stated as such. The last column applies the rule of early-tangle: a tangle stopped when its log passes 100,000 lines, which on seed44 was inside 532 s of wall clock, and it is 532 for every tangle because the rule reads the same place in every log. That column is an ARITHMETIC PROJECTION and not a measurement: no growth has ever been stopped by that rule.
